posts.title: Consumption vs Production
posts.description: I like the axis of Consumption vs Production as one lens for categorizing my hobbies. At the simple level, reading is a Consumption habit, whereas writing is Production. Then you get blurrier - watching TV is definitely Consumption, but what about debating the latest episode on Reddit? Playing videogames, Consumption, but playing videogames socially, like in an MMO?
